scope: 32 fixed control queries; finite scalar50/full analytic training; solve-only covariance budget; no application/SDD speedup

residual_audit.qualification: solve-error identity in exact arithmetic; excludes cross/prior NUFFT error, analytic-action numerical error, mean/centering error and roundoff/PSD projection

direct_validation.qualification: sampled direct rows validate numerical action consistency, not the full residual norm or an interval bound

gpu_process_audit.qualification: Periodic process samples can miss short-lived GPU work; no other job was stopped.
